mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days because it reflects accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index level above 200 (indicating elevated inflation) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days because it signals the central bank may raise interest rates to combat inflation, increasing equity discount rates.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 200 but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points and an increase in residential investment (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% over the past month signals a strengthening labor market and housing demand, which together predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to robust economic growth supporting corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and RSAFS rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE fall > 0.2pp and RSAFS rise > 0.5%) occurs but S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days because it signals a labor market recovery that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a UNRATE decline > 0.1pp is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days because it reflects strong consumer demand and economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: HOUST is above 2200 (thousands of units) but S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly INDPRO reading below 105.0 (index, 2017=100) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days because it signals a contraction in industrial output that may lead to lower corporate earnings and increased recession risk.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 105.0 but S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past month signals a tight labor market that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to higher discount rates and reduced economic growth prospects.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp and UNRATE fall > 0.1pp) occurs but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of such instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high housing demand regime (HOUST > 2200), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% over the past month predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days because it signals sustained consumer demand and economic growth that supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: In high housing demand regimes (HOUST > 2200), a HOUST rise > 0.5% is followed by negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.
